hero.headline: The day is scattered.
hero.sub: The work is not in one place.

fragmented.block1:
Meetings lived in documents, tasks on a board, talk in a messenger.
The answer was always somewhere, and nowhere.
fragmented.block2:
What we lost was not time.
It was the gaze that could have stayed.

unified.headline: Now the work is in one place.
unified.caption: What was scattered returns to that place.

data.title: Numbers live where they are.
data.body: Not a picture. A living table.

wiki.title: Wiki
wiki.body: A record that branches as it grows.

board.title: Board
board.body: Three faces of one work — kanban, backlog, gantt.

channel.title: Channel
channel.body: Talk that does not leave the work.

data.title: Data
data.body: Tables that live inside the page.

closing.price: Free for five. After that, only what you use.
closing.import: Existing docs, tasks, and talk come over with the import tools.
closing.trust: Documents and conversations are not used to train AI.
closing.headline:
The day came together.
Now you can stay.
